description: Find when the caller has nothing booked — open slots of a given length, within working hours

day_end.description: Latest hour of the day to offer, 0-23 (default 18)

day_start.description: Earliest hour of the day to offer, 0-23 (default 9)

from.description: Start of the window to search, RFC3339, e.g. 2026-08-03T00:00:00+01:00. Defaults to now

minutes.description: How long a slot you need, in minutes (default 30)

to.description: End of the window, RFC3339. Defaults to a week after from

name: events_free
title: Find free time
